description: This is the Kotlin source code for MainActivity in an Android TV application. It handles the main user interface, including a sidebar navigation with dashboard and settings sections, focus management for TV remote navigation, and fragment transactions to display different screens within a single activity.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: MainActivity serves as the entry point for the Smart Home TV app, managing the main UI components and navigation between Dashboard and Settings fragments.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the UI, and configures sidebar navigation.

methods.name: roundedFocusBackground
methods.description: Creates a drawable with rounded edges and stroke for focus highlighting.

methods.name: setupSidebar
methods.description: Configures focus and click behaviors for sidebar navigation items.

methods.name: showSection
methods.description: Switches the main content area to display the selected section's fragment and shows a toast message.
